item.title: Watch: Tide of rubbish blankets Philippines river
item.description: Workers in Manila waded through the river, collecting waste that washed in during days of heavy rain.

item.title: Watch: Why was Trump smuggled out of Air Force One in a catering truck?
item.description: US media reports say the president secretly left via a catering truck to avoid a threat to his life from Iran.

item.title: Watch: What is it like to travel on Air Force One with Trump?
item.description: Donald Trump secretly swapped planes as he left a Nato summit in Turkey last month, deceiving even the press pool who flew on board without him.

item.title: In shattered Cali, residents search for loved ones and signs of hope
item.description: Most deaths from the magnitude-7.4 quake were reported in Cali, Colombia’s third-most populous city, as crews search collapsed buildings for those still trapped.

item.title: Baby Shark boy set to make K-pop debut
item.description: The boy from the most-watched YouTube video of all time is now 17 years old, and wants to be a K-pop star.

item.title: How a 97-year-old escaped deadly Indian floods on a banana log raft
item.description: A 97-year-old's dramatic rescue captures how Assam's floods are reaching places once thought safe.

item.title: Brother of man trapped under rubble in Colombian quake clings on to hope
item.description: BBC Mundo has gone to the site of Torres del Limonar, a collapsed building in Cali where rescue workers fight to free survivors.

item.title: Decoys to hide presidents are common - but elaborate Trump ruse was different level
item.description: Deceptions of varying complexity are often used to thwart potential threats, former Secret Service agents say.

item.title: These seaside apartments were a ghost city - then police say scammers moved in
item.description: Malaysia's Forest City was pitched as "paradise" but last month police raided it over alleged scam operations.

item.title: France bans unsolicited telemarketing calls
item.description: Cold calling is coming to an end in France, with one consumer group calling the ban a "small revolution".

item.title: New Zealand PM survives second leadership challenge ahead of election
item.description: Christopher Luxon says he has "full support" of his party, after a vote of confidence 12 weeks before a general election.

item.title: Bondi Beach shooting hero's assault charges dropped by police
item.description: Police charged Ahmed al Ahmed in June after an alleged incident with his father at a Sydney home.

item.title: Lebanon parliament votes to abolish death penalty
item.description: The new law - which next goes to the cabinet for approval - would make Lebanon the first country in the Middle East to end capital punishment.

item.title: US says helicopter fired missiles to disable ship breaking Iran blockade
item.description: US Central Command says its helicopter hit the engine room of a Panama-flagged cargo vessel in the Gulf of Oman.

item.title: Tata Group Chairman N Chandrasekaran to step down in February
item.description: Chandrasekaran said he would not seek reappointment when his term ends due to a lack of support from the Tata Sons board.

item.title: Cristiano Ronaldo marries long-time partner Georgina Rodríguez
item.description: The couple have tied the knot after the Portuguese captain played his last ever World Cup this summer.

item.title: At least 44 die as ferry sinks in Zimbabwe's Lake Kariba
item.description: The vessel is said to have overturned after being hit by strong waves.

item.title: Wisconsin result dents winning streak for Democratic Party's left wing
item.description: Centrist David Crowley is projected to have beaten democratic socialist Francesca Hong, breaking a recent nationwide trend.

item.title: Zhu Rongji, who helped turn China into a trading giant, dies at 97
item.description: The former premier brought China into the WTO and championed reforms that fuelled growth.

item.title: Singapore and S Korea pull Trader Joe's seasoning over poppy seeds
item.description: Trader Joe's Everything But the Bagel seasoning contains poppy seeds which are banned in both countries.

item.title: Danube river's low water levels reveal remains of WWII soldiers and motorcycle
item.description: A remarkably well-preserved motorcycle and identification tags were found alongside the bodies.

item.title: US inflation eases as food and fuel costs cool
item.description: Annual US inflation dipped to 3.4% in July, with food costs slowing and housing keeping prices slightly higher.

item.title: Israeli settlers besieging Palestinian families in West Bank village
item.description: Israeli security forces have reportedly withdrawn and about a dozen settlers are said to remain at the site where two families have been besieged since Sunday.

item.title: Woman pulled alive from rubble 36 hours after Colombia quake
item.description: Following a 10-hour rescue operation, emergency workers pulled the 32-year-old from beneath slabs of concrete.
